page.overview:
What is Mad Monks of Xo?

The Mad Monks of Xo were an organization which was "silenced" by the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk sometime during or before 3 ABY.

The Mad Monks of Xo were first mentioned in the short story "Tooth and Claw" by Michael Kogge, published in From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back.
